name: Greek Words 1–100
description: Common Greek nouns, pronouns, adjectives and adverbs, numbers 1–100 on the frequency list. Nouns come with their article, plural and genitive; adjectives with their feminine and neuter forms.

cards.definition: Links a description to a noun: the person or thing that…

examples.text: Ο φίλος που μένει δίπλα είναι γιατρός.
examples.translation: The friend who lives next door is a doctor.

examples.text: Αυτό είναι το βιβλίο που σου είπα.
examples.translation: This is the book (that) I told you about.

cards.notes: Never changes form. Without an accent; with an accent, πού means "where?".

cards.definition: Weak form of εγώ: "my" after a noun, "me / to me" before a verb.
cards.notes: After a noun it means my (ο φίλος μου); before a verb, (to) me (μου δίνεις…;).

cards.definition: Points to a person or thing, or refers back to one already mentioned.

examples.translation: This is my brother. / He is my brother.

cards.notes: Often left out as a subject, since the verb already shows the person: Είναι εδώ = He/she/it is here.

cards.definition: Makes comparisons: πιο + adjective = more … / …-er.

examples.text: Η Αθήνα είναι πιο μεγάλη από τη Θεσσαλονίκη.

cards.notes: Than = από: πιο ψηλός από μένα = taller than me. The most = ο πιο: ο πιο καλός = the best.

cards.definition: To a great degree.
cards.notes: Πάρα πολύ = very much. The adjective is πολύς, πολλή, πολύ (much, many).

cards.definition: Used to say no, or to negate a word that is not a verb.
cards.notes: To negate a verb use δεν: Δεν ξέρω = I don't know.

cards.definition: Used to ask about something, and in exclamations.

examples.translation: How are you? (literally "What are you doing?")

cards.notes: Never changes form.

cards.definition: In what way; used in questions.

examples.translation: What's your name? (literally "How do they call you?")
How do I get to the centre?

cards.notes: Πώς! on its own = Of course! Without an accent, πως = that: Λέει πως θα έρθει = He says (that) he'll come.

cards.definition: Weak form of εμείς: "our" after a noun, "us / to us" before a verb.
In company with someone or something.
cards.notes: Μαζί με = together with: μαζί με τον φίλο μου.

cards.definition: An unspecified thing.

examples.translation: Do you want something to drink?

cards.notes: Never changes form. Before a noun it means "some": κάτι φίλοι = some friends.

cards.definition: The person speaking.
cards.notes: Usually left out, because the verb ending already shows "I": Είμαι = I am. Use εγώ for emphasis.

cards.definition: One more time.
cards.notes: Also ξανά. Πάλι καλά = it's just as well.

cards.definition: No more than; nothing but.
cards.notes: Όχι μόνο… αλλά και… = not only… but also…. The adjective μόνος means alone.

cards.definition: The whole of something; every one.
cards.notes: Όλοι = everyone, όλα = everything. As an adverb, όλο = constantly: Όλο αργεί = He's always late.

cards.definition: At the present moment.
cards.notes: Μέχρι τώρα = until now, so far.

cards.definition: In or to this place.

examples.translation: I've been living here for two years.

cards.notes: Εδώ και… = for (a period up to now): εδώ και ένα μήνα = for a month.

cards.definition: Weak form of εσύ: "your" after a noun, "you / to you" before a verb.
cards.notes: Γεια σου = hi / bye.

cards.definition: In or to a lower place.

examples.text: Το κλειδί είναι κάτω από το τραπέζι.
examples.translation: The key is under the table.

cards.notes: Κάτω από = under. Opposite: πάνω.

cards.definition: Different from the one already mentioned; one more.

examples.text: Ο ένας μιλάει, ο άλλος ακούει.

cards.notes: Άλλο ένα = one more. Τίποτα άλλο; = Anything else?

cards.definition: In this way.
cards.notes: Έτσι κι έτσι = so-so.

cards.definition: In or to what place?
cards.notes: With an accent = where?; without one, που = that, who, which.

cards.definition: In or to that place.

examples.text: Τα κλειδιά είναι εκεί, στο τραπέζι.
examples.translation: The keys are there, on the table.

cards.notes: Opposite: εδώ.

cards.definition: Before anything else.

examples.text: Πρώτα θα φάμε και μετά θα βγούμε.
examples.translation: First we'll eat and then we'll go out.

cards.notes: The adjective is πρώτος = first.

cards.definition: In or to a higher place.

examples.text: Το βιβλίο είναι πάνω στο τραπέζι.
examples.translation: The book is on the table.

cards.notes: Πάνω σε = on; πάνω από = above, over. Opposite: κάτω.

cards.definition: In or to some place.

examples.translation: Shall we go somewhere to eat?

cards.notes: With numbers it means "about": κάπου είκοσι = about twenty.

cards.definition: Up to now; in addition.
cards.notes: Also ακόμη. Ακόμα ένα = one more.

cards.definition: In or into a place.

examples.text: Τα κλειδιά είναι μέσα στην τσάντα.
examples.translation: The keys are in the bag.

cards.notes: Μέσα σε = in, within: μέσα σε μια ώρα = within an hour. Opposite: έξω.

cards.definition: At all times.

examples.translation: I always drink coffee in the morning.

cards.notes: Για πάντα = forever.

cards.definition: To such a degree.
cards.notes: Τόσο… όσο… = as… as…: τόσο ψηλός όσο εγώ = as tall as me.

cards.definition: At no time; at any time.

examples.text: Δεν έχω πάει ποτέ στην Κρήτη.
Έχεις δει ποτέ αυτή την ταινία;
examples.translation: Have you ever seen this film?

cards.notes: For "never" with a verb, add δεν: Δεν πίνω ποτέ = I never drink. On its own: Ποτέ! = Never!

cards.definition: The one person you are talking to.
cards.notes: To be polite, or to talk to several people, use εσείς.

cards.definition: In a good way.

examples.translation: — How are you? — Fine, and you?

cards.notes: The adjective is καλός = good. Καλά! on its own = OK!

cards.definition: A person or thing that is not named.

examples.translation: Someone is knocking at the door.

cards.definition: No longer; finally.
cards.notes: Usually with δεν: δεν… πια = not… anymore.

cards.definition: To a small degree; for a short time.
cards.notes: The adjective is λίγος, λίγη, λίγο (little, few): λίγοι φίλοι = few friends.

cards.translation: as much as; as long as, while
cards.definition: To the same degree as; during the time that.

examples.translation: Take as much as you want.

examples.text: Όσο ήμουν στην Αθήνα, έμενα σε ξενοδοχείο.
examples.translation: While I was in Athens, I stayed in a hotel.

cards.notes: Τόσο… όσο… = as… as….

cards.definition: A period of 24 hours; also the time when it is light.

examples.translation: I work eight hours a day.

cards.notes: Formal form: η ημέρα. Κάθε μέρα = every day.

cards.definition: Time in general; also a year.

examples.text: Του χρόνου θα πάμε στην Ιταλία.
examples.translation: Next year we'll go to Italy.

cards.notes: Του χρόνου = next year. Χρόνια πολλά! = Many happy returns!

cards.definition: A man, woman or child.

examples.translation: Lots of people came to the party.

cards.notes: The plural οι άνθρωποι is the everyday word for "people".

cards.definition: An object, or a matter.
The state of being alive; the way someone lives.

examples.text: Μένω εδώ όλη μου τη ζωή.
examples.translation: I've lived here all my life.

cards.definition: One instance of something happening.

examples.text: Ήρθα στην Ελλάδα για πρώτη φορά.
examples.translation: I came to Greece for the first time.

examples.text: Πίνω καφέ δύο φορές τη μέρα.
examples.translation: I drink coffee twice a day.

cards.notes: Μια φορά = once; κάθε φορά = every time. For time in general, use χρόνος or ώρα.

cards.definition: The part of the body at the end of the arm; also the whole arm.

examples.translation: He shook my hand. (literally "gave me his hand")

cards.notes: Greek uses χέρι for both hand and arm.

cards.definition: The part of the body you see with.
cards.notes: Το μάτι is also the blue charm against the evil eye.

cards.definition: The clear liquid that falls as rain and that people drink.

examples.text: Το νερό της θάλασσας είναι κρύο.

cards.definition: A building or place where someone lives.

examples.text: Το σπίτι τους έχει μεγάλο κήπο.
examples.translation: Their house has a big garden.

cards.notes: Στο σπίτι = at home.

cards.definition: A young person; also someone's son or daughter.
cards.notes: Παιδιά! is also a friendly "Guys!".

cards.definition: An adult female person; also one's wife.
An adult male person; also one's husband.

examples.text: Ο άντρας της είναι από την Κύπρο.

examples.translation: A man is asking for you.

cards.notes: Also spelled άνδρας (more formal).

cards.definition: The earth and everyone on it; also people in general, a crowd.

examples.text: Θέλω να γυρίσω όλο τον κόσμο.
examples.translation: I want to travel the whole world.
There were a lot of people at the beach.

cards.notes: In the singular, ο κόσμος often just means people, a crowd.

cards.definition: A job, or the activity of working.
cards.notes: Οι δουλειές του σπιτιού = housework, chores.

cards.definition: A reason for something; also a spoken word or a speech.
cards.notes: Τα λόγια (a separate plural) = words, what someone says.

cards.definition: A place or area; a part of something.

examples.translation: It's a nice place for a holiday.

cards.notes: Informally, το μέρος also means the toilet.

cards.definition: A road or street; the way to somewhere.
cards.notes: Στον δρόμο = on the way; in the street.

cards.definition: Large in size or amount; for people, older.

examples.text: Ο μεγάλος μου αδερφός μένει στο Λονδίνο.
examples.translation: My older brother lives in London.

cards.notes: Comparative: μεγαλύτερος = bigger, older.

cards.definition: Not large in size or amount; for people, young or younger.

examples.text: Όταν ήμουν μικρός, έμενα στη Ρόδο.
examples.translation: When I was little, I lived in Rhodes.

cards.notes: Comparative: μικρότερος = smaller, younger.

cards.definition: Of high quality, pleasant, or kind.
cards.notes: Comparative: καλύτερος = better. The adverb is καλά = well.

cards.definition: Recently made or started; for people, young.

examples.text: Οι νέοι χρησιμοποιούν πολύ το διαδίκτυο.
examples.translation: Young people use the internet a lot.

cards.notes: Οι νέοι = young people. Τι νέα; = What's new?

cards.definition: Coming before all others.

examples.text: Είναι η πρώτη μου φορά εδώ.

examples.translation: We live on the first floor.

cards.notes: The adverb is πρώτα = first, at first.

cards.definition: Not different; the very same person or thing.
cards.notes: Μου είναι το ίδιο = it's all the same to me.

cards.definition: A large amount or number of.

examples.translation: There was a lot of traffic on the road.
I have a lot of things to do.

cards.notes: Irregular. The adverb πολύ means very, a lot.

cards.definition: The kind of work someone does for a living.

examples.translation: What do you do for a living?

cards.definition: The word a person or thing is called by.
cards.notes: In conversation, Πώς σε λένε; is the usual way to ask someone's name.

cards.definition: The top part of the body, with the face and brain.
The part of the body you stand on; also the whole leg.
cards.notes: Greek uses πόδι for both foot and leg.

cards.definition: The organ that pumps blood; also feelings and kindness.

examples.translation: Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

cards.definition: A person you know well and like.

examples.translation: I'm going out with friends tonight.

cards.notes: Ο φίλος μου can also mean "my boyfriend".

cards.definition: A female parent.

examples.text: Η μητέρα μου είναι από την Κρήτη.

cards.notes: In everyday speech: η μαμά.

cards.definition: A male parent.

examples.text: Ο πατέρας μου δουλεύει σε τράπεζα.
examples.translation: My father works in a bank.

cards.notes: In everyday speech: ο μπαμπάς.

cards.definition: An informal word for mother.

examples.text: Η μαμά μου μαγειρεύει πολύ ωραία.

cards.definition: An informal word for father.
cards.notes: When calling to him: μπαμπά!

cards.definition: A son of the same parents as you.

examples.text: Έχω έναν αδερφό και μια αδερφή.
examples.translation: I have a brother and a sister.

examples.text: Ο αδερφός μου είναι μεγαλύτερος από μένα.
examples.translation: My brother is older than me.

cards.notes: Also αδελφός (formal). Τα αδέρφια = siblings.

cards.definition: A daughter of the same parents as you.
cards.notes: Also αδελφή (formal).

cards.definition: A male child of a parent.

examples.text: Ο γιος τους είναι πέντε χρονών.
examples.translation: Their son is five years old.

cards.definition: A female child of a parent.

examples.text: Έχουν μια κόρη και έναν γιο.
examples.translation: They have a daughter and a son.

cards.definition: A raised line of water moving across the sea.

examples.translation: The sea is rough today. (literally "has waves")

cards.notes: Also figurative: κύμα ζέστης = heatwave.

cards.definition: The time of darkness between evening and morning.
cards.notes: Τη νύχτα = at night. Καληνύχτα = good night.

cards.definition: The early part of the day.

examples.translation: I wake up early in the morning.

examples.text: Θα σε δω αύριο το πρωί.

cards.notes: Normally used only in the singular. Το πρωί = in the morning; καλημέρα is said until around midday.

cards.definition: The end of the day, before night.

examples.translation: What are you doing this evening?
Every evening I read before I go to sleep.

cards.notes: Καλησπέρα = good evening. Απόψε = tonight.

cards.definition: A period of sixty minutes; the time shown on a clock.

examples.translation: I've been waiting for you for an hour!

cards.notes: Είναι ώρα να… = it's time to…. Στην ώρα = on time.

cards.definition: A nation with its own land and government.

examples.text: Η Ελλάδα είναι μια όμορφη χώρα.

cards.notes: On many islands, η Χώρα is also the name of the main town.

cards.definition: A large place where many people live and work.

examples.text: Η Θεσσαλονίκη είναι η δεύτερη μεγαλύτερη πόλη της Ελλάδας.
examples.translation: Thessaloniki is Greece's second largest city.

cards.definition: A person who lives next to or near you.

examples.text: Ο γείτονάς μας έχει έναν μεγάλο σκύλο.
examples.translation: Our neighbour has a big dog.
The neighbours make a lot of noise.

cards.definition: Coins and notes used to buy things.

examples.translation: How much money do you need?

cards.notes: Always plural; the everyday word. More formal: τα χρήματα.

cards.definition: A panel that opens and closes an entrance.
The land along the edge of the sea.

examples.text: Το χωριό είναι πάνω στην ακτή.
examples.translation: The village is right on the coast.

examples.text: Οι ακτές της Κρήτης είναι πανέμορφες.
examples.translation: The coasts of Crete are beautiful.

cards.definition: A strip worn around the waist; also an area.

examples.text: Η Ελλάδα είναι σε άλλη ζώνη ώρας.
examples.translation: Greece is in a different time zone.

cards.notes: Ζώνη ασφαλείας = seatbelt.

cards.definition: A mother and father.

examples.text: Οι γονείς μου μένουν στην Αθήνα.
Πάω για φαγητό στους γονείς μου.
examples.translation: I'm going to my parents' for a meal.

cards.notes: Almost always used in the plural.

cards.definition: Parents, children and other relatives.

examples.text: Περνάω τα Χριστούγεννα με την οικογένειά μου.
examples.translation: I spend Christmas with my family.

cards.definition: A woman or girl you know well and like.

examples.text: Η φίλη μου η Ελένη μένει στην Πάτρα.
examples.translation: My friend Eleni lives in Patras.

examples.text: Πάω για καφέ με μια φίλη.
examples.translation: I'm going for a coffee with a friend.

cards.notes: Η φίλη μου can also mean "my girlfriend". Male: ο φίλος.

cards.definition: A female child or young woman.

examples.translation: The girl is playing in the garden.

cards.notes: Grammatically neuter, even though it means a girl.

cards.definition: A male child or young man.

examples.translation: The boy is running on the beach.

cards.notes: Grammatically neuter. Το αγόρι μου = my boyfriend.

cards.definition: A person who visits a place or a person.

examples.text: Το μουσείο έχει πολλούς επισκέπτες το καλοκαίρι.
examples.translation: The museum has many visitors in summer.

cards.definition: A polite word for a man, also used before his surname.

examples.translation: A gentleman is waiting for you.

cards.notes: When addressing someone: κύριε. Κυρίες και κύριοι = ladies and gentlemen. As an adjective, κύριος = main.

cards.definition: A polite word for a woman, also used before her surname.

examples.text: Η κυρία στο ταμείο είναι πολύ ευγενική.
examples.translation: The lady at the till is very polite.

cards.definition: The front of the head; also a person.

examples.text: Το δωμάτιο είναι για δύο πρόσωπα.
examples.translation: The room is for two people.

cards.notes: In grammar: πρώτο πρόσωπο = first person.

cards.definition: The opening in the face used for eating and speaking.

examples.translation: Don't talk with your mouth full!

cards.definition: The part of the body you hear with.

examples.translation: She whispered it in my ear.

cards.definition: The part of the face you smell and breathe with; also the pointed end of something.
